info.title: WebEngine MCP server - observe and interact with web/mobile apps for AI coding agents.
info.description: WebEngine MCP server: observe and interact with web (Selenium) and mobile (Appium) apps over MCP stdio/HTTP for AI coding agents.

options.name: --profile
options.description:
Tool set to expose (default: both, respects appsettings IsEnabled flags).
web    = Selenium browser tools only  -> plugin 'webengine-web'.
mobile = Appium device tools only     -> plugin 'webengine-mobile'.

options.name: --transport
options.description:
Transport to use (default: http for backward compatibility).
stdio is required for Copilot/Codex/Claude local plugins.
